units.en: The ⟦0⟧ is a landlocked minor power in Eastern Europe with a population of ⟦1⟧. It borders ⟦2⟧ to the north, ⟦3⟧ to the east, ⟦4⟧ to the south, and ⟦5⟧ to the west.

After the end of World War I, ⟦0⟧ was dissolved, forming two independent states: ⟦1⟧ and ⟦2⟧. The country quickly descended into an internal political conflict that caused the government to be changed thrice (First Republic, Soviet Republic and First Republic again). The country also waged wars against ⟦3⟧ and ⟦4⟧. In 1920, ⟦5⟧ was forced to sign a Treaty of Trianon, which cut it's territory by 2/3 and forced the country to limit is army. The same year, admiral Miklós Horthy marched into Budapest, where he proclaimed the country to be a Kingdom and declared himself regent of a newly-formed state.

Horthy ruled Hungary as an authoritarian dictatorship. Increasing support in fascism caused him to approve pro-German governments in 1930s. By 1938 ⟦0⟧s main economic partner was the ⟦1⟧. From 1938 to 1941, Hungarian territory grew significantly, gaining Southern Slovakia in November 1938 after First Vienna Award, Subcarpathian Rus in March 1939 during the division of ⟦2⟧, Northern Transylvania in September 1940 after Second Vienna Award and parts of Slovenia and Vojvodina in April 1941 after the joint invasion of ⟦3⟧. This was made possible by a military alliance with ⟦4⟧, which was signed in October 1940.

⟦0⟧ got a unique national focus tree as part of the ⟦1⟧ expansion. Ever since the DLC's integration, it is now available in the base game. With ⟦2⟧, It gained a completely revamped focus tree.
For the tree available with the ⟦0⟧ DLC:
The Hungarian national focus tree can be divided into 5 branches, 24 sub-branches and 1 joint branch:
These focuses start the ⟦0⟧ branch of the tree.
Reinstate the Pragmatic Sanction of 1713 sub-branch
This focus start the Habsburg paths of the ⟦0⟧ branch of the tree.
Aid the Carlist Struggle sub-branch This focus available if La Résistance is enabled, allows Hungary send aid to Carlist Spain

Invite Otto to the Throne Sub-branch This path sets Otto von Habsburg as Emperor of Austria. It allows the The The Austro-Hungarian joint branch. The leftmost section joins or creates a faction, demands the installation of an Austro-Hungarian selected monarch to the throne of Mexico, Poland, Spain, Ukraine, Georgia and Albania and make them puppets. The Rightmost section demands former Austro-Hungarian territory as puppets, as well as the annexation of Palestine for the Habsburg claim on Jerusalem.
Attempt Economic Independence Sub-branch The shared Habsburg focuses give military bonuses as well as the Hussars.

The Old Habsburg King Sub-branch The alternative Habsburg path makes Joseph August von Habsburg as Emperor of Austria. It gives military bonuses, land from Austria and bonuses against the Soviet Union for Ukraine.

A Declaration of Intentions Sub-branch The Shared Alternative Habsburg/Horthy Monarchy section gives war goals against neighboring countries, and war goals against territory from Austria to the Caucasus and Istanbul and Syria to Sudan or Communist countries.
Abide by the Little Entente's Stipulations Sub-branch
This focus sets up the alternative ⟦0⟧ paths and installs a non-Habsburg Monarch.

Establishing a New Dynasty Sub-branch This installs Admiral Miklós Horthy or his son István Horthy as King of Hungary. It allows Hungary to join the Allies as well as take the Austrian owned Burgenland (975)
Cancel the German Trade Deal Sub-branch This shared Horthy and Democratic Monarchist focus dissolves the Gömbös Trade Treaty with Germany
Elect A Democratic King Sub-branch This selects Carl V Wilhelm of Sweden as King of Hungary. It may form the United Kingdoms of Sweden and Hungary and ask Romania to join the union.

Elect a Fascist King Sub-branch This selects Friedrich Franz of Mecklenburg-Schwerin, a Fascist aligned noble as King of Hungary. The rest of the path will be shared with the Historical Fascist branch.
This starts the historical branch of the tree.
This reinforces Admiral ⟦0⟧ as head of the Hungarian government.

Renounce the Treaty of Trianon/Parties of Hungarian Life and Renewal Sub-branch The shared Fascist Monarchy and Horthyist focuses renounce the Treaty of Trianon, give Political Power, Stability and War support, as well as military bonuses.
Reestablish the Rongyos Gárda Sub-branch The shared Horthyist and Fascist focus gives militia units, Manpower and generals.

The Turul Association/Fiat Tankettes/Seek German Contracts/Promote Hungarianism Sub-branch The shared Horthyist and Fascist and Fascist monarchy path give military bonuses as well as expansion paths to create Greater Hungary.
The path removes Horthy from government. It gives military bonuses and War Goals against major or neighboring ⟦0⟧ nations.

Our Ancestral Lands Sub-branch The hidden focus only available to the path if it takes both Strengthen the Turáni Vadászok and Wherever the Cross Points gives claims on Finno-Ugric and Turkic territory.
This starts the Republican branch of the tree. It prepares a civil war against Horthy and the ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧
The ⟦0⟧ path gives research and industry bonuses as well as conquest paths across the Pannonian Steppe. It allows the The ⟦1⟧. It also gives war goals against major non-⟦2⟧ nations in Europe.
The ⟦0⟧ path brings Hungary into the Comintern with ⟦1⟧ support bonuses and pressure towards its neighbors.

Restore the Hungarian Red Army Sub-branch The shared Soviet and Socialist path gives the The Hungarian Red Army which gives Recruitable population at the expense of construction speed and factory output. It will then give bonuses against dissident activities.
Restore the Socialist Federative Republic Sub-branch
The ⟦0⟧ path gives Hungary its own faction, as well as expansion throughout the Balkans and ⟦1⟧ ultimately culminating in a war with the ⟦2⟧
The industrial branch gives Hungary bonuses in industry, construction, research and resources.
The Military branch secretly rearms Hungary against the ⟦0⟧. It may also request aid from ⟦1⟧
Make the Magyar Légierö Known Sub-branch
The airforce section gives research bonuses for Hungary's airforce.
Initiate Army Maneuvers/Invest in Ludovica Academy Sub-branch
The army section gives research bonuses, special forces bonuses and land defenses.
Sailing the Danube/Reinstate the Haditengerészet Sub-branch
The navy section gives research bonuses for Hungary's navy.

The Austro-Hungarian joint branch gives military and industry bonuses to Czechoslovakia and other members within historical Austria Hungary. This branch allows any member/subject to complete the focus. The originator will be able to form ⟦0⟧. It is unlocked when Hungary completes the focuses ⟦1⟧ or ⟦2⟧.
The Austro-Hungarian joint branch, available with the ⟦0⟧ DLC:
The Austro-Hungarian branch can be divided into 4 sections:
Gives army experience and research bonuses to army research, and as well as national spirits for every type of infantry unit.
Gives economic experience and research bonuses in joint cooperations, as well as national spirits for economy.
Builds civilian factories (usually even if building slots are already full), infrastructure and grants national spirits for the industry wise.
Convene the Imperial Diet/United in the Face of Danger Sub-branch
This is done either by Hungary or Austria which gives a final modification on every member's national spirit, as well as grant a small political power, but with the cost of daily autonomy loss.
For the tree available without the ⟦0⟧ DLC:
The Hungarian national focus tree can be divided into 3 branches and 6 sub-branches:
This branch allows Hungary to change its political stance.

This branch allows Hungary to end the regency and elect either a Democratic king (Carl V Wilhelm of ⟦0⟧), a Fascist king (Friedrich Franz of Mecklenburg-Schwerin of ⟦1⟧), or a Non-Aligned Habsburg king (Otto von Habsburg of ⟦2⟧) as their ruler.
The Democratic king means closer ties with ⟦0⟧ and either joining the ⟦1⟧ and the Allies or allying with ⟦2⟧.
The Fascist king means aligning more with ⟦0⟧ and the Axis and striving to create a ⟦1⟧. This sub-branch joins the ⟦2⟧ Sub-branch.

The Non-Aligned Habsburg king is the most unusual, as it involves starting an endeavour to rebuild the fallen ⟦0⟧ by reuniting with ⟦1⟧ and ⟦2⟧ (and therefore opposing and resisting German designs for said countries) and generating claims on lost lands in ⟦3⟧, ⟦4⟧, ⟦5⟧ and northern ⟦6⟧. The end of the sub-branch awards even more claims on territories in ⟦7⟧, ⟦8⟧, central ⟦9⟧, and the ⟦10⟧ Levant.
This branch allows Hungary to become Fascist and create a ⟦0⟧ and either join the Axis or create their own faction with ⟦1⟧.
This branch allows Hungary to become Communist and join the ⟦0⟧ and the Comintern, or create their own faction.
This branch allows Hungary to develop its industry and unlock research slots. One of its sub-branches is connected to the Establish the Air-Force sub-branch.
This branch allows Hungary to cast off the Treaty of Trianon and start researching military tech.
This sub-branch allows the research and licensing of the Airforce.
This sub-branch gives research bonuses for various types of Army equipment.
This sub-branch deals with the Navy but requires that Hungary controls a coastal state as they lack one in 1936.
